highlights: Earn up to 6 % cashback on shopping and daily rides, capped at S$50 for shopping and S$20 for transport per calendar month, with a minimum spend of S$800 per calendar month. Plus, earn extra 3.25% cashback on selected overseas spend in Asia, capped at S$50 per calendar month. Additionally, enjoy unlimited 0.3% base cashback on all eligible spend.
pros: Get up to 6% cashback on Shopping and Transport spend
pros: Get unlimited 0.3% cashback on all spend
pros: Earn an extra 3.25% cashback on In-store Overseas Spend at your favourite destinations in Asia from Japan, Malaysia, Thailand and more
pros: Enjoy first-year annual fee waiver
pros: Enjoy more fresh deals and exclusive perks
pros: Spending on the card and crediting your salary can earn you 0.05% p.a. or more on your DBS Multiplier account
cons: Min. monthly spending of S$800 required to earn up to 6% cashback on Shopping and Transport spend
cons: Cashback on Shopping spend capped at S$50 per calendar month
cons: Cashback on Transport spend capped at S$20 per calendar month

extra.description: Get the most out of your daily spends with the DBS Live Fresh Card, which lets you score up to 6% cashback on your shopping sprees and daily commutes.
